Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
kw...@cs.cornell.edu (Alan Kwan) writes:

>Situation: me and opponent both played "Blur" for additional
>strikes.

>Question: concerning Acrobatics (Superior), which of the
> following is true:

>(a) I can't play Acrobatics for a Dodge during Additional
> Strikes.
>(b) I can play Acrobatics for a Dodge during Additional
> Strikes; the "with Additional Strike" part of
> the card is ignored.

(a) would apply since Acrobatics gains additional strike(s), and only
one such card may be played per round per minion.

General rule: you cannot ignore parts of cards' text for realism.
(or for any other purpose, for that matter :-)
If it said Strike: dodge with an optional additional strike, then OK.

Messages.Author: Martin Filion
Messages.Body:
Alan Kwan (kw...@cs.cornell.edu) wrote:

> Situation: me and opponent both played "Blur" for additional
> strikes.

> Question: concerning Acrobatics (Superior), which of the
> following is true:

> (a) I can't play Acrobatics for a Dodge during Additional
> Strikes.
> (b) I can play Acrobatics for a Dodge during Additional
> Strikes; the "with Additional Strike" part of
> the card is ignored.

You can't use a card when you have at least one thing in it that isn't
good. So the answer would be no for (a) and no for (b).

Another example would be using bonding superior to Stealth a political
vote. The +1 bleed is illegal, so you can't use it.
